I replied to Pree in our DM to confirm that their standing call with the Tansleigh Packaging team for the Moorland rollout is now Mondays at 9:30.

I didn't change anything, since they said no action was needed. I also told them I have no separate memory store, so the note only lives in our DM history. I offered to add a recurring Monday 9:30 event to their calendar if they want a reminder they can see.
